SHOP BY COLLECTION WOMENS WADERS LIFESTYLE APPAREL FLY BOXES AND MORE WOMAN OWNED & WOMAN CENTERED Miss Mayfly's mission is to transform the women's fishing experience through innovative product design, proprietary sizing technology, and an unwavering commitment to quality, integrity, and ethical business practices. We exist to ensure women are fully represented, supported, and equipped to succeed on the water. "At Miss Mayfly, we strive to provide the best in fit, comfort and stability while ensuring the ultimate strength and durability of our products. Driven by a passion for inclusivity, Miss Mayfly has made significant strides in making fly fishing more accessible to all. Yet, this is just the beginning of our journey. With an unwavering commitment to our mission, we aspire to continue breaking barriers, fostering inclusivity, and transforming the future of fly fishing." -Kimberly Ranalla, Miss Mayfly Founder HEAR WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS HAVE TO SAY... from 201 reviews It was difficult to find my girlfriend a quality pair of waders until I discovered Miss Mayfly. They're stylish, form-fitting, comfortable, and come in a great color! The customer service was outstanding, especially when we needed to exchange them for a better-fitting pair. After a couple of trial runs in Colorado, we finally had the chance to put them to the test in Alaska. Miss Mayfly waders exceeded our expectations and outperformed every other pair we've tried. They kept her comfortable and dry through long days on the water while chasing sockeye salmon and rainbow trout. The fish didn't stand a chance! Thanks, Miss Mayfly, for making such an excellent product and for providing exceptional customer service. She couldn't be happier! Michael S. These waders are amazing - so comfortable, even hiking long distances in them and spending long days wearing them. To have waders that actually fit so well is terrific, and the convenience of waist high pants over chest waders can't be beat when in the field for long days. Best purchase I've made in a long time Robin Roberts Talk about great waders. I took them out in a maiden voyage this weekend on a fly-fishing walk and wade trip near the Yellowstone River with Project Healing Waters Fly Fishing Inc. I am a veteran and just picked up fly fishing. I am plus size and have borrowed men's waders for other trips. They have worked, but we're never overly comfy. These were great. The booties that fit were delightful. I also have Miss Mayfly boots and they were comfy and warm. In Montana I was a little worried I was going to get cold, but NOPE! Just a base layer on bottom and a sweatshirt on top and I was fine. Fit was great. Anonymous Fit is as described and chest, inseam, foot are perfect. While I wish it came in Petite full, there is ample room for a fleece and jacket. Can’t wait to test drive them! Harriet Beckerman I got my miss mayfly’s after trying to find other waders that fit short girls with HIPS. All the other waders I tried left lots of material in weird places, which affected my balance and comfort. My miss mayfly’s were 3 years old by the time I went to Alaska and I had full confidence in bringing them. They lasted above and beyond in harsh conditions, climbing over trunks, and even when I fell in Klawock. They dried fast enough to be worn the next day also! I’m still wearing them and they are still holding up beautifully. Thank you Miss Mayfly for recognizing the need for inclusive and great fitting waders for us ladies! Mary B These waders are amazing! I am a taller woman (5’9) and 125 lbs with size 9.5 feet and finding waders That would fit me was just not happening (the feet were too small and the waders too big). I was so excited to find Miss Mayfly! They fit perfectly and I love them! Thank you for the size customization! Lani Williams I’d been searching for a wading pant that fits my body (which is hard to find in normal pants!) and this is as close as I think I will ever get! Very well designed and I love that they are easy to get on/off. I have a smaller waist and bottom, but large calves and feet. I ended up getting the 8/9 curvy and they fit perfect in my lower legs and feet. The waist/bottom area is a little on the large side, but being able to cinch the two belts up makes them work well! When I am fishing, I don’t care what I look like, but these still look great in my opinion. I will be purchasing wading boots when my size is back in stock. Missi Losasso Great pants. TheThey would be perfect, if they had pockets for your hands! If you put anything hard in the front pocket, it makes it challenging to climb up the bank. Fit great! I’m only 5 ft tall so was thrilled to find wafers that fit me! Kimberly Burke I can’t wait to get these waders in the river! I was REALLY worried they wouldn’t fit my calves, but they do just comfortably enough. My next move was going to be custom waders, but these fit perfectly. Anna I placed an order for boots five days before I was going on vacation. Called customer service and she, we got it upgraded to 2 day shipping. I got the boots in time to fish among the buffaloes in Yellowstone National Park. Amazing product and amazing customer service. Karen SMITH I struggled with finding waders that allowed me to climb and hike. Often they were to restrictive in the thigh and hip area, making it difficult to get where I needed. I’ve put some miles on in these waders, and I feel comfortable, confident and most importantly safe. Jackie Used your sizing chart, and fit is perfect! Thanks for creating an awesome set of waders for girls with curves! Paige Bickford I can’t say enough about the waders. They are comfortable and with the sizing options I was able to find a perfect fit. They are lightweight and keep you completely dry when used. I am 5’6 and on the heavy side. Size 18 Women’s in pants and shirts. Having a women’s option insured a roomy fit with booties that are appropriately sized and comfortable inside a wading boot. I highly recommend this product. You won’t be disappointed. Anonymous What excellent customer care! Thank you, Kim. I received my order for Moxie waders (waist high), after some quick coaching about Miss Mayfly's unique sizing and they fit like a dream - while standing. But I'm no novice and tried some knee bends and large stair stepping. The "rise" was a little short, giving me concern about bending down to release a fish or stepping out of the river onto a steep bank. Miss M thought I might need to go to the next size in "Curvy" and sent them right out. Now they were a little baggy in the knees and bottom, but the bootie was a little more comfie and I decided the larger size was going to be the safer bet for movement. A day in my favorite meadow confirmed it. I've been watching this company grow for several years and wish Kim and the Miss Mayfly family success upon success. Donna Luallen Customer Service is top notch. Kim was so patient with all of my questions throughout my sizing consult...but let's talk about these amazing waders! I can bend down and touch the water. I couldn't do that in my previous boot waders. I can move so very easily in these. The fit is absolute perfection in every way. I'm short and chunky and never thought I would find waders to fit me. These fit so good!!! They also catch fish. I seriously could not be happier with this purchase. Even better that they are women designed and by a small business by an amazing lady that is practically in my back yard. I'm so happy I found these! SHERRY FOR WOMEN, BY WOMEN We've been there. Your body is unique. Your waders should be too. AWARD WINNING Our Women's Waders and Boots have been put to the test, and have come out the best. EASY RETURNS & EXCHANGES Fit matters. We're here to ensure you are comfortable for long days on the water. BUILT FOR ADVENTUROUS WOMEN.
